criteria.title: Named landform and subfeatures
criteria.question: Cross-section/planform, visible subfeatures, area/scale, meaningfully corresponding features
criteria.rule: Review only with both feature-applicable maps/images

criteria.title: Surface material / deposit classes
criteria.question: Published lithology, regolith, layers, sediment size, bedrock context, mineral analyses if measured
criteria.rule: Source-linked selected material, do not infer from color

criteria.title: Geologic process
criteria.question: Impact; lava emplacement; collapse; fluvial/lacustrine transport; ice models
criteria.rule: Source applies to precise feature, distinguish proposed vs observed

criteria.title: Exploration activity tag
criteria.question: Mapping; sampling; robotics; sensor test; navigation
criteria.rule: Activity justified by documentation, never safety approval

criteria.title: Slope over same support
criteria.question: Raster in local projection meters, consistent spatial support and scale

criteria.title: Local topographic roughness
criteria.question: Standard deviation of valid elevations on fixed-radius neighborhood after consistent resampling

criteria.title: Window local relief
criteria.question: Maximum minus minimum within same physical area

criteria.title: Geologic unit area
criteria.question: Digitized geologic whole-fan polygon or source area
criteria.rule: body-appropriate polygon area; no analogy score alone

criteria.title: Channel length density
criteria.question: Total mapped channels / selected surface area

criteria.title: Visible obstacle fraction
criteria.question: Same detection threshold and measured-resolution surface imagery

criteria.title: Lighting and permanent shadows
criteria.question: Latitude season terrain shadow geometry; local solar horizon
criteria.rule: Keep unscored; Moon south pole very different from Arctic summer

criteria.title: Ice / water and subsurface geometry
criteria.question: Ground truth radar/geology/sampling for water ice / lava cave
criteria.rule: Do not infer subsurface from surface DEM

criteria.title: Effective spatial resolution
criteria.question: Native GSD, interpolated areas, source dates and quality flags
criteria.rule: Native resolution is NOT output-pixel spacing

criteria.title: Vertical reference / coordinate systems
criteria.question: Earth EGM96 vs Moon reference radius vs Mars are different vertical datums
criteria.rule: Absolute altitude differences across planets forbidden

practice.label: Impact-landform observation
practice.reason: NASA and LROC sources document impact-related landforms, blocks, crater textures, and feature interpretation at the selected scopes.
practice.limitations: This supports observation practice only; it does not validate scientific equivalence or field safety.

practice.label: Robotic mapping
practice.reason: NASA documents field mapping and rover-access work at Haughton, while LROC provides a mapped Shackleton rim view for traverse planning.
practice.limitations: Earth operations do not reproduce lunar gravity, vacuum, lighting, or communication conditions.

practice.label: Traverse planning
practice.reason: The paired sources describe bouldered or blocky terrain and access or traverse interpretation at each feature scope.
practice.limitations: No matched slope, obstacle-density, route-clearance, or landing-site analysis has been completed.
